required_residual_obligations.claim: Analytic near-integrable Hamiltonians on a regular action-angle domain with nondegenerate Hessian retain Diophantine invariant tori for a quantitatively sufficiently small analytic perturbation. Diophantine means |k·ω|≥γ|k|^{-τ} for all nonzero integer k, γ>0,τ>n−1. Analytic norm is supremum on a fixed complex strip/action neighborhood.
required_residual_obligations.checkpoint_missing: Complete small-divisor/Newton iteration, analytic loss estimates, parameter inversion and positive-measure frequency-set argument. None of the four read texts proves it; SICM §4.6 explicitly omits proof.

required_residual_obligations.claim: A specified smooth mechanically adopted perturbed system with a verified transverse homoclinic intersection has a compact invariant return-map set conjugate to a two-symbol shift.
required_residual_obligations.checkpoint_missing: Stable/unstable manifold construction, controlled splitting estimate for a chosen mechanical model, transversality and full horseshoe conjugacy. E12 proves only the abstract shift and return-map regularity.

required_residual_obligations.claim: General nonlinear continuum initial/boundary well-posedness, shocks and viscous extensions beyond the explicit smooth transport/linear wave branches.
required_residual_obligations.partial_new_discharge: E23 completes scalar Burgers characteristics/entropy shock and rarefaction, exact viscous Couette/Poiseuille; E24 completes smooth infinite string Fourier Cauchy problem. Generic nonlinear systems/rough-boundary well-posedness still not proved.
required_residual_obligations.checkpoint_missing: Specific constitutive PDE/function-space/boundary contract and complete local existence/uniqueness or weak-solution arguments. E14 solves the stated one-dimensional linear Cauchy problem, not all PDEs.
required_residual_obligations.scope_reconciliation: The old untyped generic extension list was not an unqualified existence theorem. Exact smooth periodic Euler/viscous IVP now proved; original rough/compressible/turbulence extensions preserved below as future specialist scope. No valid specified theorem was removed.

required_residual_obligations.claim: Analytic exponentially long modified-Hamiltonian error control for symplectic integration on a bounded domain under step restrictions.
required_residual_obligations.checkpoint_missing: Analytic modified series estimates, optimal truncation and domain/time bounds. E15 supplies finite-time order-two convergence and separate roundoff only.

required_residual_obligations.claim: Global smooth regularity of general three-dimensional incompressible Navier–Stokes data.
required_residual_obligations.missing: Known open mathematical problem; not promoted to theorem, not allowed as a prerequisite.
